scope: Capability issuance and consumption, orchestration bridge checks, host workflow-turn binding, accepted and rejected follow-up actions, current local-pilot observations, and the source drift observed during the investigation.
excluded_scope: External identity provider, administrator host policy, operating-system sandbox enforcement, network access, fresh host smoke, product-code changes, and claims about stores other than the inspected local-pilot SQLite store.
executive_answer: The runtime enforces several local integrity and continuity constraints, but it does not establish an independently authenticated chain of authority. Capabilities are minted from caller-supplied or repository-declared identity and evidence fields; logical action scope is enforced, while human legitimacy and filesystem, tool, model, network, and delegation limits are not. Exact follow-up recipient continuity is proven only when the prior terminal binding has a non-null agent identity. The inspected local-pilot store contained zero binding rows for this dispatch at the observation time.
property_served: Know who authorized an action, what limits actually constrained it, and whether accepted and rejected actions can be reconstructed.

claims.statement: Capability possession, exact action and phase, expiry, record/context digest, one-shot consumption, and semantic identity of duplicate bridge records are mechanically enforced; these checks establish local integrity, not legitimacy of the authorizer.
evidence_for: implementations/server/runtime/capabilities.py:60-128 and 150-167 implement issuance, validation, expiry, digest checks, revocation, and consumption.
implementations/server/runtime/orchestration_bridge.py:86-141 and 218-230 check scoped authority values and reject divergent idempotent retries.
Focused orchestration-bridge accepted-open/close and divergent-retry tests passed in an isolated temporary store.
evidence_against: The bridge test setup invokes .claude/skills/register-dispatch/append-dispatch.cjs, which is absent from both investigation source manifests; corpus-bounded proof is therefore partial.
missing_evidence: A pinned copy or digest of the executable appender used by the tests.
Independent authentication of the issuing principal and authorization evidence.
claims.implication_for_harness: A valid token proves that the local protocol accepted a scoped assertion; it does not yet prove who had the right to make that assertion.

claims.statement: Capability issuance and host policy identity are self-asserted inside the governed path: callers choose the principal and scope, and the host hook checks evidence shape and pinned digest syntax without authenticating a signer or resolving authoritative evidence bytes.
evidence_for: implementations/server/runtime/capabilities.py:60-97 accepts caller-selected principal, action, phase, context, and expiry.
implementations/server/runtime/host_dispatch_hook.py:125-150 loads syntactically valid policy fields and lines 210-255 self-mint the grant.
implementations/server/runtime/service.py:5202-5221 validates non-empty evidence fields and SHA-256 shape, not signer identity or referenced bytes.
missing_evidence: An independently authenticated principal, immutable authorization artifact, and verified signature or equivalent trust root.
claims.implication_for_harness: The system can reconstruct what authority was claimed, but cannot yet prove that the claimant possessed that authority.

claims.statement: For a terminal prior turn with a non-null bound agent, the service accepts a follow-up to that exact agent and rejects a different target with AuthorizationError; the rejected path has no durable denial receipt.
evidence_for: implementations/server/runtime/service.py:5488-5535 binds prompt/template/manifest and checks prior terminal agent continuity.
implementations/tests/runtime/test_host_workflow_binding.py:337-364 passes the exact-agent action and rejects the different-agent action for a non-null fixture.
evidence_against: The test setup depends on the unmanifested appender, and the AuthorizationError path does not persist a denial receipt.
missing_evidence: A durable reason-coded denial receipt and a corpus-complete isolated proof.
claims.implication_for_harness: Positive continuity can be reconstructed for the tested state, but rejected intent disappears and therefore cannot support later audit or recovery.

claims.statement: The declared per-seat filesystem, tool, model, network, and no-spawn limits are requested constraints, not observed runtime fences.
evidence_for: implementations/as-built/dispatch-payload.json: effective_enforcement records non-observable provider/tool enforcement and observable artifacts rather than OS-level confinement.
The inspected runtime capabilities constrain logical operations; no inspected enforcement point applies the full seat sandbox to subsequent tool execution.
missing_evidence: Host- or OS-level enforcement receipts for each requested limit.
claims.implication_for_harness: The dispatch records intended limits but cannot claim that the worker was technically unable to exceed them.

claims.statement: At 2026-07-31T18:54:56.1708639Z, a read-only query of the inspected local-pilot SQLite store returned zero host_workflow_turn_bindings rows for this dispatch. This is point-in-time evidence only and does not prove that no binding ever existed or that another store was not used.
evidence_for: Read-only query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_workflow_turn_bindings WHERE dispatch_id=? against telemetry/runtime/local-pilot/aci-apt-stage-c.sqlite3 with parameter 2026-07-31-implementation-as-built-reconciliation returned 0.
evidence_against: The receipt did not establish by immutable store hash and same-store dispatch link that this was the unique store used by the active host.
missing_evidence: A store hash plus same-store dispatch_links and orchestration-open correlation, or an actual binding receipt for this dispatch.
claims.implication_for_harness: The investigation itself is registered in YAML but is not presently reconstructible through the runtime binding path from the inspected store.

gaps.statement: No independent trust root authenticates the principal or human authorization evidence.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Bind issuance to an authenticated principal and immutable signed authorization artifact outside the constrained actor's control.
gaps.what_it_buys: A defensible answer to who authorized the work and why that actor had the right to do so.
gaps.completion_evidence: A negative test rejects self-asserted identity and a positive receipt links issuer, signed evidence digest, scope, and consumed capability.

gaps.statement: Seat-level filesystem, tool, model, network, and delegation limits are not enforced by the runtime.
gaps.property_lost: Ability to prove that agents could not exceed declared authority.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Choose an enforceable host or OS sandbox boundary and bind its policy/receipt to each seat.
gaps.what_it_buys: Technical confinement rather than a prompt-level promise.
gaps.completion_evidence: Adversarial tests are blocked for every prohibited operation and emit durable reason-coded receipts.

gaps.statement: A terminal prior turn may have agent_id=NULL, in which case follow-up recipient equality is skipped.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Require non-null agent identity for resolved spawn turns or reject follow-up when it is null; add null/missing/arbitrary-target tests.
gaps.what_it_buys: No follow-up can escape the identity established by the prior turn.
gaps.completion_evidence: A null-agent follow-up fails closed before launch and records a durable denial reason.

gaps.statement: Rejected follow-up authorization is not durably recorded.
gaps.property_lost: Reconstruction of attempted unauthorized work and the reason it was stopped.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Append a reason-coded denial event before returning AuthorizationError.
gaps.what_it_buys: Auditable negative decisions and evidence for policy improvement.
gaps.completion_evidence: Rejected target test leaves one immutable denial receipt correlated to dispatch, seat, turn, actor, and rule.

gaps.statement: The executable dispatch appender used by the bridge and tests is outside both source manifests.
gaps.property_lost: Complete reproducibility of the authority proof corpus.
gaps.smallest_next_action: Include and hash the appender and its transitive executable dependencies in the source manifest.
gaps.what_it_buys: A test result whose full executable path is frozen and reviewable.
gaps.completion_evidence: Manifest verification covers the appender bytes and the focused suite passes from that sealed corpus.
